design.problem: P24C MEASURED the P24B handover and returned INSUFFICIENT, INSUFFICIENT and INSUFFICIENT_BRIDGE: the four declared inputs were not closed under their own imports, no handed-over file named the type the generator demands, and no handed-over file ever put payload bytes on disk. A team following the protocol could not reach the reference consumer at all
design.additionOnlyAmendment: the fenced protocol block changes in exactly ONE way: three entries are APPENDED to requiredInputs, for the contract type, its renderer and one materializer CLI. No key is added to that block, none is removed, reworded or reordered, and no acceptance number moves. The first four entries and every other key carry byte-identical values
design.blockAuthorityScoped: the document used to say the block was the authority and the prose added no rule the block omits. That is no longer true and the correction is written into the document rather than left implied. The block remains the authority on who counts, on acceptance, on falsification and on evidence, and it declares WHICH files are handed over. It does not carry the rules for USING them
design.proseCarriesWhatIsLearned: the type a team constructs, its six rules in the type's own declared order, the payload layout and the CLI usage line are prose and become no key in the block. The document says so explicitly, in the paragraph above the block and again at the head of the two sections that carry those rules. The six rules are checked against the type's own OPTIONS list rather than against a second copy of the same belief
design.materializerCli: one file, three arguments: contract JSON, distribution version, existing empty target directory. It lets ActionContract itself decide whether the contract is acceptable, renders the P24A consumer diagnostics distribution and writes that file map byte for byte. It imports only node builtins and two OTHER declared inputs, so the handover stays closed under its own imports
design.containment: the target must already exist and hold nothing; the CLI never creates it and never overwrites what is there. Every generated path is checked BEFORE the first byte is written, so a payload declaring a path that climbs out of the target leaves the target exactly as found and writes nothing outside it
design.determinism: no process.env read, no clock, no network and no random source. The same three arguments produce the same payload bytes and the same one-line report every time
design.failClosed: every refusal exits 1, prints nothing on stdout and emits exactly one anchored MATERIALIZE_ERROR:<CODE> line. Codes: MISSING_ARGUMENT, CONTRACT_UNREADABLE, CONTRACT_REFUSED, TARGET_NOT_EMPTY, PATH_ESCAPE

ownerFacing.once: P24C olcumu su cevabi vermisti: disaridaki ekibe verilen dort dosya yetmiyor. Uretici daha ilk satirda duruyordu, sozlesme nesnesinin nasil kuruldugu hicbir yerde yazmiyordu ve paketi diske yazacak adim kutuda yoktu.
ownerFacing.simdi: Kutuya uc dosya daha kondu: sozlesme tipi, o tipi isteyen uretici ve paketi diske yazan tek komut. Belgenin duz metnine de sozlesmenin alti kurali, paketin icinde ne cikacagi ve komutun tam yazilisi eklendi. Protokolun makine okur blogunda tek degisiklik bu uc satirin sonuna eklenmesi; hicbir kabul sayisi, hicbir kural degismedi. Belge ayrica kendisi hakkinda soyledigi yanlis bir cumleyi de duzeltti: blok kimin sayildigi, kabul sarti ve kanit konusunda hala son soz, ama bu uc dosyanin nasil kullanilacagini blok tasimiyor, duz metin tasiyor.
ownerFacing.fark: Ayni uc olcum araci, tek harfi degismeden yeniden calisti ve ucu de SUFFICIENT dedi. Dahasi, sadece bu yedi dosyayi tutan bos bir klasorde, elle hicbir yardim olmadan, sozlesme dosyasi yazilip komut calistirildi ve ornek tuketici komutun yazdigi paketi kabul etti.
ownerFacing.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM'in 'musteri olustur' aksiyonunu disaridaki bir ekibe verdigimizi dusunun. Once: kutuyu aciyorlar, urediciyi calistiriyorlar, program acilmiyor bile. Simdi: ekip kendi aksiyonunu kucuk bir JSON dosyasina yaziyor, tek komutu bos bir klasore dogru calistiriyor, komut o klasore uc dosya birakiyor ve ornek tuketici o klasoru okuyup tek satirlik saglikli raporu yaziyor. Yanlis bir sey yazarlarsa komut hicbir sey yazmadan tek satirlik anlasilir bir ret veriyor ve klasoru buldugu gibi birakiyor.
ownerFacing.kalanEngel: Paketi yazmayan taze bir reviewer onayi ve CI'daki ikinci tam QA bekleniyor. Kutu artik acilir durumda ama disaridan sayilmis ekip sayisi hala 0, sahibin ne kadar yardim ettigi hala olculmedi, P24 hala acik ve hicbir hazirlik bayragi kalkmadi.
